where can i store photo images of my purchases reciepts

You can store photo images of your purchase receipts in your Google Drive. Ogeemo's document management system is designed to work with a dedicated "Receipts" folder within your Google Drive. You can also use the "Images" folder for general image storage.

Once your receipts are in the "Receipts" folder, Ogeemo can scan and sync them.
